question: Which is the outermost covering of the cell that separates the contents of the cell from its external environment?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Plasma membrane**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **plasma membrane** is the outermost covering of the cell that separates the contents of the cell from its external environment.
 
• The plasma membrane is also known as the **cell membrane**.
 
• It is a **semipermeable membrane** that controls the movement of substances in and out of the cell.
